Class View<S extends Screen>

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.View<S>
Type Parameters:
S - The type of Screen used by this view, must extend the Screen class
All Implemented Interfaces:
ErrorReporter, ModelObserver
Direct Known Subclasses:
CliView, GuiView
public abstract class View<S extends Screen> extends Object implements ModelObserver, ErrorReporter
Abstract base class for different view implementations in the Galaxy Truckers game. This class implements the Model-View-Controller pattern by connecting to both the model and controller components. It also acts as an observer of the model, receiving and processing updates when the model changes.

Concrete implementations of this class (CLI and GUI views) handle the actual rendering and user interaction aspects specific to each view type.
